description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (`PosterAdapter`) for displaying a list of poster items in a horizontal list, along with the data class `PosterItem`. It handles view inflation, data binding using Coil for image loading, and provides an update method to refresh displayed data.

classes.name: PosterAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter that displays a list of poster items as horizontal cards with images loaded via Coil.

classes.name: PosterViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds the ImageView for each poster item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates the view for a poster item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a PosterItem to the ViewHolder, loading the poster image and setting content description.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of poster items.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data list with new items and refreshes the display.
